mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, boosting equity risk appetite and generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.0 million units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which typically precedes broader demand weakness and triggers a risk-off shift in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicate a supply-side shock combined with labor market stress, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 106.0 and UNRATE > 5.5%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above $440 billion over two consecutive months signals strong underlying demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three months, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that may delay rate cuts, increasing real yields and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage pressures and Fed rate hikes, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized over the past six months, combined with a decline in housing starts, indicates a weakening demand environment that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
